data.name: Khizarah
data.gender_notes: Khizarah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'khizr', meaning 'moon' or 'crescent'. In Islamic tradition, it refers to the light of the moon, which is a symbol of guidance and protection. The name Khizarah carries the meaning “Moon's light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khizarah usually hope their child will grow to embody moon's light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the beginning of a new day, filled with hope and potential.
data.etymology: Khizarah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon's light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khizarah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: خزارة
in_arabic.meaning: خزارة تعني الخصوبة و الزيادة في الخير و البركة
in_arabic.long_meaning: خزارة هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'خَزَرَ' والذي يعني الخصوبة و الزيادة في الخير و البركة. يستخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الخصوبة وزيادة الخير. و يرتبط هذا الاسم بالعديد من المعاني الإيجابية مثل الثراء و النجاح.

in_urdu.name: خزاریہ
in_urdu.meaning: خزاریہ کا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی، خیر و برکت، اور زرخیزی
in_urdu.long_meaning: خزاریہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی، خیر و برکت، اور زرخیزی۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ خصوبة اور خوشحالی کی علامت ہے۔ اس نام کی اصطلاحی عربی زبان سے نکلی ہے جہاں اس کا مطلب ہے 'خَزَرَ' یعنی جمع کرنا اور اکٹھا کرنا۔

in_hindi.name: खिज़ाराह
in_hindi.meaning: खिज़ाराह का अर्थ है सुंदरता, समृद्धि और उर्वरता
in_hindi.long_meaning: खिज़ाराह एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सुंदरता, समृद्धि और उर्वरता। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि यह उर्वरता और समृद्धि का प्रतीक है। इस नाम की व्युत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है जहां इसका अर्थ है 'ख़ज़र' यानी एकत्र करना और जमा करना।

in_pashto.name: خزاره
in_pashto.meaning: خزاره د ښکلا، برکت او زرخیزۍ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: خزاره د عربي نوم دی چې د ښکلا، برکت او زرخیزۍ معنی لري. دا نوم د اسلامي کلتور لپاره مهم دی ځکه چې د زرخیزۍ او خوشحالي نښه ده. د دې نوم ريښه د عربي ژبې څخه اخستل شوې ده چې د 'خَزَرَ' په معنی دی، يعنی راغونډول او ټولګې.

in_english.name: Khizarah
in_english.meaning: Khizarah means beauty, prosperity, and fertility in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: Khizarah is an Arabic name that signifies beauty, prosperity, and fertility. It is rooted in the Arabic culture and Islamic tradition, symbolizing abundance and blessings. The etymology of Khizarah traces back to the Arabic root 'خَزَرَ' (khazara), meaning to collect or gather, reflecting the concept of accumulation of good and prosperity.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Khizarah" carries cultural significance as it is reminiscent of the crescent moon and star, a revered symbol in Islamic art and architecture. This symbol is often used as a decorative motif and is associated with the Islamic Golden Age. It is also a common name for cities, mosques, and other Islamic institutions.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic spiritual tradition, the crescent moon is a symbol of the divine guidance provided to Prophet Muhammad through the angel Gabriel (Jibril). The name "Khizarah", derived from the Arabic word 'khizr' meaning 'moon', signifies the notion of receiving guidance and protection from the divine. It is a reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge and wisdom, as well as staying connected to the divine source, in order to navigate the challenges of life.
